# Retrieval Assets

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_cses_wiki.py. Review before manual editing. -->

Use these files when the agent has keyword or vector-search capability.

- `chunks.jsonl`: retrieval-ready chunks from `knowledge_base_final/`.
- `source_map.json`: source-path metadata keyed by source document path.
- `chunk_index.md`: human-readable chunk count by topic.
- `eval_questions.jsonl`: routing/evaluation prompts for regression testing.

Recommended embedding text:

```text
{context}

{text}
```

Recommended metadata filters:

- `topic`
- `year`
- `status`
- `doc_type`
- `source_path`
